notes: test_move.c exercises wall collision through the movement frames; the connects() body is shared with BlockFence, whose record carries the same citation. Pinned by lane/meshvar's mesh scene (out/java/rendertick/mv_variants, 13 views mv_variants_*, each within its budget with no pxdiff cluster; the scene's sections match the oracle's sections.bin vertex for vertex): cobblestone and mossy walls: lone posts, lines along x and z, into a stone block, an L, a T, a cross, a mixed line, a line under a block, a two-high line and a fence gate between walls (a cobblestone wall drawn with the mossy icon measures 18,056 px over 25 against 82).
